title: ArkEval: Benchmarking and Evaluating Automated CodeRepair for ArkTS
abstract: arXiv:2602.08866v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models have transformed code generation, enabling unprecedented automation in software development. As mobile ecosystems evolve, HarmonyOS has emerged as a critical platform requiring robust development tools. Software development for the HarmonyOS ecosystem relies heavily on ArkTS, a statically typed extension of TypeScript. Despite its growing importance, the ecosystem lacks robust tools for automated code repair, primarily due to the absence of a high-quality benchmark for evaluation. To address this gap, we present ArkEval, a unified framework for ArkTS automated repair workflow evaluation and benchmark construction. It provides the first comprehensive benchmark specifically designed for ArkTS automated program repair. translated_title: ArkEval：ArkTS自动代码修复的基准测试与评估
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型已变革代码生成，实现了软件开发中前所未有的自动化。随着移动生态系统的演进，HarmonyOS已成为一个需要强大开发工具的关键平台。HarmonyOS生态系统的软件开发主要依赖于ArkTS，这是一种TypeScript的静态类型扩展。尽管其重要性日益增长，但该生态系统缺乏用于自动代码修复的稳健工具，主要原因是缺少高质量的评估基准。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了ArkEval，一个统一的框架，用于ArkTS自动修复工作流的评估和基准构建。它提供了首个专门针对ArkTS自动程序修复设计的全面基准。我们通过从包含超过400个独立ArkTS应用的大型官方华为仓库中挖掘问题来构建此基准。通过严格的多阶段过滤过程，我们精选出...（摘要被截断）
tldr: 提出了首个专为ArkTS设计的自动程序修复基准ArkEval，通过挖掘华为大型仓库中的问题构建，填补了该领域评估工具的空白。
en_tdlr: ArkEval introduces the first comprehensive benchmark for ArkTS automated program repair, constructed by mining issues from a large-scale Huawei repository, filling the gap in evaluation tools for this ecosystem.
